title: ScientificRecord
description: Schema for immutable scientific laboratory records in VAULT.

record_id.description: Unique identifier of the laboratory experiment record

threshold_mg_per_l.description: Regulatory or safety limit threshold in mg/L

method_id.description: Identifier of the measurement and calculation methodology

original_verdict.description: Verdict submitted by the researcher at observation time

available_fraction.description: Availability factor when method calculates bioavailable or available fraction

calibration_date.description: Timestamp or date of last instrument calibration

calibration_valid_until.description: Expiration timestamp or date of instrument calibration

source_refs.description: References to SOPs, instrument IDs, or protocol documents
